observations: Photo 0 shows a silver laptop with a black keyboard and trackpad, held open by a hand.
The screen is off and reflects the surroundings, including a wooden door and pink wall.
The keyboard has visible wear and smudges, especially on the right side.
The trackpad has a small crack or chip near the center, visible in the photo.
The laptop appears to be a MacBook Pro, as indicated by the 'MacBook Pro' text on the bezel below the screen.
No ports, hinges, or underside are visible.
No charger or battery is shown.
The seller claims it is a 17-inch Late 2011 MacBook Pro with 50% battery health, 5% physical damage, and no charger, but the photos do not show the battery health or physical damage details.

claims.evidence: The 'MacBook Pro' text is visible on the bezel in photo 0, but the model year and size cannot be confirmed from the photo alone.
No battery health indicator or diagnostic screen is visible. The claim cannot be verified from the photo.
Photo 0 shows a crack on the trackpad, but the extent and location are not clearly defined. The claim of '5%' damage is vague and not quantifiable from the photo.
No charger is visible in the photo. The claim cannot be confirmed without seeing the charger or its condition.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Battery health is not 50% as claimed
risks.proof: A screenshot of the battery health report from macOS or a diagnostic tool showing the actual battery health percentage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if battery health is unknown or degraded, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Physical damage is more than 5% or not as described
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the trackpad crack and other visible damage, including under the screen and around the ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if damage is moderate to severe, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Laptop is not a 17-inch Late 2011 model
risks.proof: Photo of the bottom case or a clear shot of the model number (e.g., 'MacBook Pro (Late 2011)') on the bottom or inside the lid.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it is an older or different model, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Laptop is not functional or has hidden hardware issues
risks.proof: Video or photo of the laptop booting up, showing the macOS desktop and running a basic task.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if not working, which reduces value significantly.

proof_requests: Photo of the bottom case showing the model number or serial number.
Screenshot of the battery health report.
Close-up photos of the trackpad crack and other visible damage.
Video or photo of the laptop booting up and running normally.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
